name: Get feature toggles
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current set of feature flags for the logged‑in account, such as whether bots tracking, compliance, or email campaign duplication are enabled. Use a different action (e.g., get account plan details) if you only need plan information rather than the full feature list.

bots-tracking.description: Indicates if bots tracking is enabled.

compliance-allowed.description: Indicates if compliance features are allowed.

dedup-customization-enabled.description: Indicates if deduplication customization is enabled.

duplicate-identifiers.description: Indicates if duplicate identifiers are allowed.

editor-beta.description: Indicates if the editor beta features are enabled.

email-campaign-duplicate.description: Indicates if duplicate email campaigns are permitted.

email-campaigns-limit-disabled.description: Indicates if the limit on email campaigns is disabled.

ent-users-push-experiment.description: Indicates if enterprise users push experiment is active.

es-new-sender-domain.description: Indicates if the new sender domain feature is enabled.

is-webpush-enabled.description: Indicates if web push notifications are enabled.

marketing-subject-ai-disabled.description: Indicates if AI‑generated marketing subject lines are disabled.

mpp-opens-tracking.description: Indicates if MPP opens tracking is enabled.

new-conversions.description: Indicates if the new conversions tracking is active.

new-signup-flow.description: Indicates if the new signup flow is enabled.

new_marketing_pressure_enabled.description: Indicates if new marketing pressure features are enabled.

plan-management-service.description: Indicates if the plan management service is available.

preview-on-email-clients.description: Indicates if preview on email clients is enabled.

self-serve-users-push-experiment.description: Indicates if self‑serve users push experiment is active.

wallet-rollout.description: Indicates if the wallet rollout feature is enabled.
